reviews.comment: The only grades are three exams. There is not any textbook but there are 5 articles you need to read. Attendance is not required but go to class! The lectures are pretty boring but they help with the exams. He did provide extra credit.

Even though this class was only graded by 3 exams, I found that attending the lectures regularly and taking notes helped me to succeed on exams. His extra credit also helped, but lectures could be dry and the material is boring if you are not interested in archaeology.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Waters is a nice guy- but he is so boring. Man is so monotone it hurts. To make things worse, the lectures that are uploaded don't have all of the necessary information for the exams, so you kind of have to go to the class. The only grades are 3 exams, but he does offer a little extra credit. If you can avoid- do it. If not you'll live.
The class was very lecture-heavy and your grade relied on just a handful of tests. However, Professor Waters was clearly very knowledgeable and experienced in his field.

Professor Waters is a good professor and is passionate about archaeology. His semester is pretty straightforward with only a few exams as your only grades. If you go and pay attention to lectures you won't have to do too much outside studying or homework.

It's clear that Dr. Waters knows a lot about archaeology and has been teaching the subject for a very long time. The only assignments you get graded on are tests, which are very easy for the most part. He's a caring guy and tries his best to explain the material to you. He will also hand out free extra credit if you attend most of the lectures.

The hardest thing about the course was that the entire grade comes from just 3 exams so it was hard for most people to get above a B. The lectures were super interesting and he was engaging and made sure students really gained an understanding of the topics.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's very sweet, and loved to see us engaging with the material and doing well on tests. Lectures could drone on, but the tests weren't hard (as long as you studied a little bit). If you can, I would take a more interesting elective, but if you're an anth major and have to take 202 with Waters, you'll be fine. A very low-maintenance class overall.

Dr. Waters is sweet and literally hands you all the information that you will need to study for the exam. Would recommend buying the course packet and meeting with the TA. His lectures are a little heavy, since he sometimes covers a lot of information, but it's nice to go and listen. He knows how to mend his field work with what he's teaching.

I like Dr. Waters as a person but his entire class is graded off of 3 tests and that stressed me out. So i struggled when it came to test time because there was so much information packed into each test. He does offer some extra credit but not a lot.

Doctor Waters has been teaching ANTH202 since before I started kindergarten. This shows. You enter the lecture hall, he starts speaking and doesn't stop until class ends. You have to be skilled at staying awake and paying attention. DO NOT BUY THE BOOK. I never cracked it and got a B, and I'm not exactly a great student. TL:DR do not take this prof
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: His lectures were always super long and boring. His power point slides are available but you have to buy them from Copy Corner I belive. Lastly, his tests and lectures are completly different. Don't take 202 with him unless you have to.

Just don't take this class unless you really have to. Hard subject to teach, but what he told us to study and what was on the test were completely different and the tests were impossible. Failed me by 1 point.

To receive a B in this class all I did was show up to class. I didn't buy the book or the course pack. Simply arrive for class caffeinated and take notes. There is a small amount of extra credit. He doesn't take attendance but highlights what is going to be on the test in class. During his review he points out things  from the notes on the test.
Buy a course pack. Everything for ems is on there. He also tells you before exams what is pretty much on the tests since he reviews. you can earn extra credit working in his lab.

Prof. Waters has to teach Archaeology, which isn't really a subject many students are interested in, but if you semi-pay attention in class, and study a bit for the test, you will be fine. Just know the terms he teaches and you can figure out the questions.

Very easy class. Prof is extremely nice and tries very hard to make it interesting. You just have to go to class, pay attention and look up words you don't know before the test. His tests are very straight forward and usually just definitions and examples he talks about in class. I would definitely recommend Dr. Waters.
What he talked about in class did not appear on tests, I think he just made them up from thin air. It was a very boring class.
this guy is the pickiest test maker ever! I got a C in the class b/c he had such picky picky questions... really interesting material, though
He's a fine teacher, but his tests cover excrutiating detail.  I wouldn't recommend him.
